tools.description: Search the code graph for symbols matching a name (exact or substring). Returns ranked matches with name, kind, file:line, and signature.

name.description: Symbol name to search for (exact or substring match).

tools.name: SearchEntity

tools.description: Retrieve full detail for a single symbol by its stable id. Returns name, kind, language, file:line, signature, and doc comment.
tools.name: RetrieveEntity

tools.description: Bounded multi-hop walk from a start symbol. Returns the subgraph (nodes, edges, depths) reachable within the given depth and node caps. Supports forward (dependencies), reverse (dependents), and bidirectional traversal. For rules engine connections: use edge_kinds=["invoked_by"] to trace code→rules, ["governs"] for ruleset→rule structure, ["evaluates"] for rule→condition.

edge_kinds.description: Edge kinds to follow (empty = all kinds).

symbol.description: Start symbol ID for the traversal.

tools.name: TraverseGraph

tools.description: Transitive dependents of a symbol (reverse-reachability on Calls edges). Answers 'what breaks if I change this symbol?' Reports coverage: resolved dependents plus the count of unresolved call-site references that could not be bound (potential missing dependents).

symbol.description: Symbol ID whose transitive dependents to enumerate.

tools.name: BlastRadius

tools.description: Return the exact source slice for a symbol (requires content to have been stored during indexing). Returns the raw source text extracted from the symbol's byte span, plus file:line for provenance. Returns found=false (no error) when the symbol is absent or its file content has not been stored.

symbol.description: Stable symbol ID whose source slice to fetch.

tools.name: FetchContent

tools.description: One-shot context bundle for a symbol: resolves the seed (by id or by name/FTS query), gathers its graph neighbours (callers + callees), ranks them by personalised PageRank, and returns the seed plus the top neighbours as token-budgeted elided stubs packed within a character budget. Replaces orchestrating SearchEntity + TraverseGraph + ContextPack by hand — use it to fill an agent's context window in a single call.

budget.description: Character budget for the packed context (default 8000, hard-capped below the ~25K agent limit).

query.description: Name / FTS text to resolve the seed (alternative to 'symbol'); the top hit is used.

symbol.description: Stable symbol ID of the seed (alternative to 'query').

tools.name: ContextBundle

tools.description: List the rules-engine RuleSet nodes in the graph with the code that invokes them, plus counts of individual Rule nodes (grouped vs ungrouped). Use this to discover what business rules engines and conformance rules are present; use rules.recall for faceted, severity-ordered recall of the Rule nodes themselves. Returns: {engines: [{name, kind, file, invoked_by: [code_files]}], total, rule_nodes: {total, in_rule_sets, ungrouped}}
tools.name: RulesInventory

tools.description: Recall the conformance rules (native Rule nodes, PAT-*/POL-* ids) that apply to a query slice. language/layer/framework are wildcard facets (a rule without the facet applies to all values), severity/rule_type are exact, scope restricts to a scope subtree by prefix. Results are severity-ordered (critical→info) then id. Read-only: rules are authored via git-tracked docs + `wicked-core rules ingest`, never over MCP.

framework.description: Wildcard facet: match rules targeting this framework OR rules with no framework facet.

language.description: Wildcard facet: match rules targeting this language OR rules with no language facet. Omit to match all.

layer.description: Wildcard facet: match rules targeting this layer OR rules with no layer facet.

limit.description: Result cap (default 100, max 500). Truncation is reported in diagnostics.

rule_type.description: Exact match on rule type (PAT-* pattern / POL-* policy).

scope.description: Restrict to a scope subtree by canonical path prefix (e.g. "wiki:architecture").

tools.name: rules.recall

tools.description: Most central symbols by PageRank over Calls+Imports edges. Answers 'what are the load-bearing symbols here?' — the code the most paths flow through. Use to orient in an unfamiliar repo, pick refactor targets, or seed a change-impact review. Optionally bias toward `seeds` for a personalized (subsystem-local) ranking.

limit.description: How many top-ranked symbols to return (default 20, max 200).

seeds.description: Optional symbol IDs to bias the ranking toward (personalized PageRank). Omit for global PageRank.

tools.name: RankHotspots

tools.description: Modularity (Louvain) communities over Calls+Imports edges, each summarized with its top-PageRank members and dominant files. Answers 'what are the natural subsystems here?' — clusters of symbols more tightly connected to each other than to the rest of the graph. Use to map an unfamiliar codebase into modules or scope a refactor to a cohesive unit.

limit.description: How many communities to return, largest first (default 20, max 200).

resolution.description: Louvain resolution γ (default 1.0; > 1.0 yields smaller, tighter communities).

tools.name: Communities

tools.description: Transitive dependencies of a symbol (forward-reachability on Calls+Imports edges). Answers 'what does this symbol depend on?' — the complement of BlastRadius. Use to understand the full dependency chain before a refactor or to build a change-impact picture from the dependency side.

symbol.description: Symbol ID whose transitive dependencies to enumerate.

tools.name: Lineage

tools.description: Capture a new memory node (episodic/semantic/procedural/archival).

scope.description: Hierarchical scope path: slash-separated kind:id segments (e.g. "org:acme/agent:claude"). Empty, omitted, or null = root. Segments that are not kind:id pairs are rejected (invalid params), never silently dropped.

tools.name: memory.capture

tools.description: Conversational recall: token-budgeted slice relevant to a query in scope. Each item carries memory_id, scope (the item's own hierarchical scope, e.g. org:acme/agent:claude), content, tier, and score. Default visibility is inheritance: memories at `scope` or an ANCESTOR of it. Pass scope_prefix to flip to subtree-inclusive visibility instead.

scope_prefix.description: Optional subtree filter: when present, candidates are memories whose scope equals this prefix or DESCENDS from it (same predicate as memory.erase/memory.coverage scope_prefix), REPLACING the ancestor-visible inheritance filter from `scope`. "" = root subtree = every memory. Omitted or null = inheritance behavior. A recall with a prefix previews exactly the set memory.erase with that prefix would delete.

tools.name: memory.recall

tools.description: Distil episodic memories in a scope into semantic facts (T2 tier). Returns distilled_facts list.
tools.name: memory.reflect

tools.description: Hard-delete all memories whose scope starts with the given prefix.
tools.name: memory.erase

tools.description: Store a semantic fact and link it to code symbols atomically.

symbols.description: exact code symbol name(s) this fact concerns

tools.name: memory.learn

tools.description: Coverage: memory node counts (total, by tier, by kind), optionally scoped.
tools.name: memory.coverage

tools.description: Ingest a document as doc + chunk nodes.
tools.name: knowledge.ingest

tools.description: Write ONE knowledge node.
tools.name: knowledge.write

tools.description: Add a typed relation between two knowledge nodes, with confidence + evidence_count + provenance.

evidence_count.description: audit counter: confirmations/contradictions (default 0; non-negative, fits u32, else -32602)

tools.name: knowledge.relate

tools.description: Hybrid recall (FTS + vector, RRF fused) over the knowledge base. Each item carries node_id, class, label, body_snippet, score, and source (provenance set at ingest, e.g. a file path or URL; empty string when not recorded). Pass scope_prefix to restrict recall to a scope subtree (the wiki convention scopes guidance as wiki:<area> with stable source URIs).

scope_prefix.description: Optional subtree filter: only knowledge whose scope equals this prefix or DESCENDS from it (same predicate as memory.recall scope_prefix, e.g. "wiki:" or "wiki:architecture"). "" = root subtree = everything. Omitted or null = no scope filtering.

tools.name: knowledge.recall

tools.description: Coverage: node counts per class, optionally within a scope subtree.

scope_prefix.description: Optional subtree filter (same predicate as knowledge.recall scope_prefix).

tools.name: knowledge.coverage

tools.description: Link a knowledge node to estate code symbols via xedge.
tools.name: knowledge.relate_code

tools.description: Recall knowledge linked to code symbols (cross-store lookup).
tools.name: knowledge.recall_about_code
